documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited reported its Q1FY27 financial performance with consolidated revenue of INR 1,432 Crores and EBITDA of INR 313 Crores. Management highlighted ongoing strategic initiatives including the development of Carbon Nanotube technology, entry into Super Speciality Carbon Black, and scaling up of new energy materials such as anode and cathode capacities. The company also reported progress in its Birla Tyres turnaround and maintained its long-term financial projections. Himadri Speciality Chemical reported Q1FY27 revenue of Rs. 1,432 Cr, EBITDA of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company targets to reach INR 3,000 Crores of top line in Birla tyres in the next 4 years to 5 years.
guidance.quote: We will continue this trajectory and in next 4 years to 5 years the target is to reach INR3,000 Crores of top line in Birla tyres.

guidance.claim: The company has committed to doubling its PAT in the next three years to INR 1,100 plus crores by FY28 from the FY25 PAT base of INR 555 crores.
guidance.quote: We have committed to double this PAT in next three years in FY28 to INR 1,100 plus crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Global lithium-ion battery demand is projected to rise from around 1.6 terawatt hours in 2025 to nearly 6.8 terawatt hours by 2035.
demand_outlook.quote: Global lithium-ion battery demand is projected to rise from around 1.6 terawatt hours in 2025 to nearly 6.8 terawatt hours by 2035.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer engagements have intensified significantly with leading Indian as well as global cell manufacturers regarding LFP chemistry.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer engagements have intensified significantly with leading Indian as well as global cell manufacturers, and the response has been strongly encouraging.

capex_expansion.claim: The company planned a capex of approximately INR 70 Crores for a 200 MTPA CNT manufacturing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: Backed by a planned capex of approximately INR70 Crores, our upcoming 200 MTPA CNT manufacturing facility targeted for commissioning in Q4FY27, is expected to position Himadri among a select group of few global manufacturers serving this high-growth market.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that 6,000 MTPA of existing capacity is being converted for Super Speciality Carbon Black with a capex of INR 170 Crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We are converting 6,000 MTPA of existing capacity with a capex of INR170 Crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a 200 MTPA anode material facility at Mahistikry in April 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: On the anode side, we have commissioned our 200 MTPA anode material facility at Mahistikry in April 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: Initial 2,000 MTPA capacity for LFP cathode chemistry is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our initial 2,000 MTPA capacity is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27, representing the first milestone under Phase 1 of our 40,000 MTPA expansion plan, which forms part of our broader long-term vision to scale capacity to 200,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: Full commissioning of forward integration into anthraquinone and carbazole with a total capacity of 5,300 MTPA is targeted by FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: Our forward integration into anthraquinone and carbazole with a total capacity of 5,300 MTPA is progressing well with full commissioning targeted by FY28.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex announced is around INR 2,000 Crores, consisting of INR 1,125 Crores for LFP, INR 368 Crores announced recently, and INR 500 Crores in Birla Tyres.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, total capex we have announced is around INR2,000 Crores, INR1,125 Crores for LFP, INR368 Crores announced yesterday. So that brings to around INR1,500 Crores of capex, plus INR500 Crores of capex this year in Birla Tyres. So total INR2,000 Crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Himadri established a 200 MTPA anode material facility at Mahistikry, West Bengal.
capex_expansion.quote: Established a 200 MTPA anode material facility at Mahistikry, West Bengal

capex_expansion.claim: The first milestone capacity of 2,000 metric tons of LFP cathode active material is targeted for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this phased execution, the first milestone capacity of 2,000 metric tons is targeted for commissioning by Q3 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: FY29 is envisaged as the year for full Phase 1 operations of the LFP cathode active material project.
capex_expansion.quote: The balance Phase 1 capacity will be progressively brought onstream over the subsequent 12 months, closely aligned with customer approvals and demand visibility, with FY29 envisaged as the year for full Phase 1 operations.

capex_expansion.claim: Sicona's pilot-scale capacity expansion is currently underway and targeted for completion by Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, Sicona has achieved important milestones at pilot scale level, with further capacity expansion currently underway and targeted for completion by Q2 FY27, supporting intensified engagement with global cell manufacturers across multiple stages of sample approvals.

capex_expansion.claim: The anthraquinone and carbazole project is progressing as planned and is expected to commission in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, our anthraquinone and carbazole project is progressing as planned and expected to commission in Q2 FY27, helping address a significant import dependency in India.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully commissioned its first anode material manufacturing facility in Mahistikry with an initial capacity of 200 metric tons per annum on April 23, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: On 23rd April 2026, we successfully commissioned operation at our first anode material manufacturing facility in Mahistikry, West Bengal with an initial capacity of 200 metric tons per annum, marking a pivotal step in our entry into lithium-ion battery materials value chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully commissioned an additional 70,000 metric ton speciality carbon black facility at Mahistikry during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, we successfully commissioned an additional 70,000 metric ton speciality carbon black facility at Mahistikry, taking our total speciality carbon black capacity to 130,000 metric tons per annum and our overall carbon black capacity to 250,000 metric ton per annum.

margins_costs.claim: Stand-alone revenue for the quarter stood at INR 1,274 Crores, EBITDA at INR 301 Crores with a margin of 24%, and profit after tax at INR 223 Crores with a margin of 18%.
margins_costs.quote: Our stand-alone revenue for the quarter stood at INR1,274 Crores as compared to INR1,100 Crores a year ago, an increase of 16%. Our EBITDA stood at INR301 Crores as compared to INR234 Crores a year ago with a growth rate of 29% and margin of 24%. Profit after tax has significantly increased to INR223 Crores from INR183 Crores a year ago, a jump of 22% with margin of 18%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the business model allows the company to transfer any increase in raw material prices to customers.
margins_costs.quote: So whether it is crude-based or coal tar-based, whatever increase in price is there, we transfer to our customers.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved a return on capital employed of 32% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our return on capital employed has also shown a steady upward trajectory, reaching 32% in FY26, a testament to our sharp focus on value creation and capital efficiencies.

orders_capacity.claim: Birla Tyres distribution network spans 49 distributors and over 1,000 dealers.
orders_capacity.quote: As of today, the distribution network spans 49 distributors and over 1,000 dealers.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a speciality carbon black capacity of 130,000 tons within a total capacity of 250,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: With 250,000 metric ton capacity, including 130,000 tons of speciality carbon black capacity, we operate across a product portfolio of more than 70 speciality grades.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates the world's largest single location fully integrated carbon complex with 600,000 MTPA of coal tar distillation capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: We operate the world's largest single location fully integrated carbon complex, with 600,000 MTPA of coal tar distillation capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Himadri operates with coal tar distillation capacity of 600,000 MTPA.
orders_capacity.quote: 600,000 MTPA of coal tar distillation capacity

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates 8 zero discharge plants across India and China.
orders_capacity.quote: 8 zero discharge plants across India & China

orders_capacity.claim: Coal-tar pitch distillation capacity was debottlenecked to reach 600,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: With the successful de-bottling of our coal-tar pitch distillation capacity, taking it to 600,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: The company established an expanding network of 43 distributors and over 1,000 dealers for Birla Tyres.
orders_capacity.quote: From a distributor standpoint, we have established a strong and expanding network of 43 distributors and over 1,000 dealers giving us a solid platform for scale.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the capex program is entirely self-funded.
capital_allocation.quote: The capex program is thoughtfully structured to balance scale with efficiency. It is entirely self-funded and deliberately calibrated between brownfield expansions, which enhance asset productivity and greenfield investments, where we are building new capabilities from the ground up.

capital_allocation.claim: As of March 31, 2026, the company holds a net positive cash balance of INR 121 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 31st March 2026, we hold a net positive cash balance of INR 121 crores, which gives us ample flexibilities to pursue growth opportunities while maintaining a prudent approach to capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: For future expansions, the company's plan is to use internal accruals only.
capital_allocation.quote: For our future expansion, our plan is to use internal accrual only for all the expansion.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that currency volatility caused forex losses during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: So this quarter, if you see 2, 3 factors. One, we have deployed a lot of fund in terms of interest in FDs. We have borrowed from bank and CPs and deployed in FDs, so which gives us a delta.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sharp depreciation in the rupee impacted the company on the import side and led to hedging losses due to volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you know, there was sharp depreciation in rupees which impacted us on the import side. And export side also, we hedged something, but generally we keep our position open. Because of this huge volatility, we hedged. Because of the hedging, we had to incur losses this time.

management_commitments.claim: The 200 MTPA CNT manufacturing facility is targeted for commissioning in Q4FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Backed by a planned capex of approximately INR70 Crores, our upcoming 200 MTPA CNT manufacturing facility targeted for commissioning in Q4FY27, is expected to position Himadri among a select group of few global manufacturers serving this high-growth market.

management_commitments.claim: The initial 2,000 MTPA LFP capacity is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our initial 2,000 MTPA capacity is expected to be commissioned in Q3FY27, representing the first milestone under Phase 1 of our 40,000 MTPA expansion plan, which forms part of our broader long-term vision to scale capacity to 200,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.claim: Birla Tyres' next strategic milestone is the commissioning of the Passenger Car Radial (PCR) facility by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Birla Tyres' next strategic milestone is the commissioning of Passenger Car Radial (PCR) facility by FY28, paving the way for its planned entry into EV and SUV tyre segments.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial operations for the India Gigafactory are on track for Q4FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Commercial operations for India Gigafactory on track for Q4FY27

management_commitments.claim: PCR facility commissioning is targeted by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: PCR facility commissioning targeted by FY28

management_commitments.claim: The first milestone capacity of 2,000 metric tons of LFP cathode active material is targeted for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: As part of this phased execution, the first milestone capacity of 2,000 metric tons is targeted for commissioning by Q3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: FY29 is envisaged as the year for full Phase 1 operations of the 40,000 metric tons per annum LFP cathode active material project.
management_commitments.quote: Execution of Phase 1 of our lithium-ion phosphate cathode active material project, which envisages a total capacity of 40,000 metric tons per annum is on track. As part of this phased execution, the first milestone capacity of 2,000 metric tons is targeted for commissioning by Q3 FY27. The balance Phase 1 capacity will be progressively brought onstream over the subsequent 12 months, closely aligned with customer approvals and demand visibility, with FY29 envisaged as the year for full Phase 1 operations.

management_commitments.claim: Sicona's pilot-scale capacity expansion is targeted for completion by Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: During the year, Sicona has achieved important milestones at pilot scale level, with further capacity expansion currently underway and targeted for completion by Q2 FY27, supporting intensified engagement with global cell manufacturers across multiple stages of sample approvals.

management_commitments.claim: The anthraquinone and carbazole project is expected to commission in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, our anthraquinone and carbazole project is progressing as planned and expected to commission in Q2 FY27, helping address a significant import dependency in India.

management_commitments.claim: Over the next 12 to 24 months, the company will progressively enhance capacity utilization for Birla Tyres supported by a product pipeline.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next 12 to 24 months, we will be progressively enhance our capacity utilization, supported by robust pipeline of new product launches across agriculture, mining and commercial vehicle segments.

management_commitments.claim: The passenger car radial (PCR) tyre is targeted for commissioning in the next 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: PCR, we target to commission in next 24 months.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
